name: Mock (saves pictures)
description: A display that shows nothing: every page is saved as a picture in a folder, with the same rest after a refresh as a real panel. For developing and trying the app without a panel.

properties.name: width
properties.title: Width
properties.description: The width of the pictures the mock display makes, in pixels (what a panel's width would be).

properties.name: height
properties.title: Height
properties.description: The height of the pictures the mock display makes, in pixels (what a panel's height would be).

properties.name: outputFolder
properties.title: Output Folder
properties.description: The folder the pictures are saved in: a name (a folder of that name in the system's temporary folder) or an absolute path. Restart after changing it.

properties.name: cleanOutputFolder
properties.title: Clean the Folder at Start
properties.description: Delete the pictures this display made earlier when it starts, so the folder holds only this run's (nothing else in the folder is touched).
